numbers.headline: Of people in hospital to stop heavy drinking, 45% had a measurably less stiff liver after one week off.
numbers.mirror: You think the damage is done, so stopping now won't change much.
numbers.counted: people in hospital to stop heavy drinking

basis.design: prospective study; each person scanned on admission and again a week later
basis.who: patients admitted to a liver and addiction unit to stop drinking; median intake 150 g of alcohol a day (about 11 US standard drinks)
basis.n: 137 patients; 62 of them had a significant drop
basis.measured: Liver stiffness on a FibroScan, the scan doctors use to estimate liver scarring, at entry and after 7 days without alcohol. The median fell from 7.2 to 6.1 kPa; the estimated scarring stage fell for 23%.

numbers.caveat: The authors take the quick drop as a sign that things other than scarring, such as alcohol hepatitis, push the reading up. 12% got stiffer. It says nothing about how people felt.
